# Welvia
Welvia makes business information and request workflows easier for people and compatible agents to use.

- [Homepage](https://welvia.app/): Services and approach.
- [Action contract](https://welvia.app/openapi.json): Business facts, questions, onboarding and request receipts.

Business pages use /business?business=<business_id> and load their content from the backend. Private owner actions and customer request tests require a business-specific invitation. The invitation must not be shared with unrelated agents or businesses. Published service rules govern requests; staff confirms availability, pricing and acceptance. A saved receipt is not an accepted order. Owner answers require review before changing approved facts. Never invent policies or ordering-provider capabilities.

## Public proposals
Business proposals at /business?business=<stable-id> are publicly viewable and do not expire. Request a free first website review through the form. Private owner actions require separate access. The free review includes recommendations and a starter file with upload instructions, delivered by email. Optional implementation and ongoing care are scoped and priced separately.
